sources.snippet: VideoMAEv2-giant model pre-trained for 1200 epochs in a self-supervised way on UnlabeldHybrid-1M dataset. It was introduced in the paper [CVPR23]VideoMAE V2: Scaling Video Masked Autoencoders with Dual Masking by Wang et al. and first released in GitHub.
